notes.summary: createAiChatHandler takes memory: a running chat summary past an auto-compact threshold, user notes and shared workspace notes, with the built-in tools memory_remember and memory_forget.
notes.howTo: Set memory on createAiChatHandler with memory.scope(request) from the verified session and a MemoryStore for user or shared notes (createInMemoryMemoryStore for tests; check a real store with verifyMemoryStore). With memory set, the history is bounded by the auto-compact threshold instead of maxContextMessages and history.maxTurns. The skill setting-up-glirastes-memory carries the SQL schema and store templates.
